title: A larger assembly
hook: Explore the evidence behind a cosmic question.

knows: Light and gravity help astronomers study the universe.
doesNotKnow: Galaxy clusters contain many galaxies, hot gas and substantial dark matter. They are large gravitational structures rather than individual galaxies.

misconception: A learner may choose: A cluster is one star with many planets
objective: Use the visual model to reason about: What distinguishes a galaxy cluster from a single galaxy?

claims.text: Question, correct answer and explanation: What distinguishes a galaxy cluster from a single galaxy? A cluster contains many galaxies together with gas and dark matter. Galaxy clusters contain many galaxies, hot gas and substantial dark matter. They are large gravitational structures rather than individual galaxies.
Visual caption: Galaxies + gas + mass. The SVG is a conceptual illustration, not measured data or a scale model.

recall.question: What distinguishes a galaxy cluster from a single galaxy?
options: A cluster has no gravitational mass
A cluster contains many galaxies together with gas and dark matter
A cluster is one star with many planets
recall.why: Galaxy clusters contain many galaxies, hot gas and substantial dark matter. They are large gravitational structures rather than individual galaxies.
